reasoning: 驗證目標：Browse 的預設類別為 All Channel Browse。為什麼這樣切：「預設」只在尚無上次瀏覽紀錄時可觀察，故前置條件要求由出廠狀態或設定重置起算，否則 096 的記憶行為會蓋過本條款。ER 指名 All Channel Browse 本身，而非其內容（那是 098／104 的判準）。與 096 的差別：本 leaf 是首次進入的預設，096 是其後的沿用（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: All Channel Browse is the default category on first entry
tcs.test_item: The default Browse category shall be All Channel Browse
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The HU settings have been reset to factory state and the Browse feature has not been used since
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Invoke the Browse feature
2. Read which category is presented
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Browse feature opens
2. The presented category is All Channel Browse
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
